handstyle-display.purpose: Primary expressive brand voice for hero moments and selected overlays.

structural-display.purpose: Large uppercase page and section architecture.

body.purpose: Body copy, navigation, CTA labels, metadata, and functional UI.

label.purpose: Small uppercase metadata and truthful section markers.

shadows.name: media-bottom-ink
shadows.purpose: Ground a photo frame without lifting it as a card.

motion.name: out-expo
motion.purpose: Expressive but controlled exits and reveals.

components.name: Primary CTA
components.description: The direct conversion action, normally WhatsApp.
components.css: .ds-cta-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1rem; min-width:13rem; min-height:3.25rem; padding:.95rem 1.1rem; position:relative; border:1px solid rgb(244 242 237 / 42%); border-radius:0; background:var(--color-ink, #f4f2ed); color:var(--color-canvas, #050505); font:720 .78rem/1 Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.075em; text-decoration:none; text-transform:uppercase; transition:color 280ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background-color 280ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-color 280ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-cta-primary::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:-1px auto -1px -1px; width:.28rem; background:var(--color-accent, #7a35ff); } .ds-cta-primary:hover { background:var(--color-surface-raised, #171717); border-color:var(--color-accent, #7a35ff); color:#fff; } .ds-cta-primary:focus-visible { outline:.16rem solid var(--color-focus, #b997ff); outline-offset:.28rem; }

components.name: Text CTA
components.description: Secondary editorial action with minimal chrome.
components.css: .ds-cta-text { display:inline-flex; gap:.75rem; align-items:center; padding:.35rem 0; border-bottom:1px solid currentColor; color:var(--color-ink, #f4f2ed); font:720 .78rem/1 Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.075em; text-decoration:none; text-transform:uppercase; transition:color 280ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-cta-text:hover { color:var(--color-accent-bright, #925bff); } .ds-cta-text:focus-visible { outline:.16rem solid var(--color-focus, #b997ff); outline-offset:.28rem; }

components.name: Editorial CTA
components.description: Oversized conversion moment for deliberate editorial emphasis.
components.css: .ds-cta-editorial { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; min-height:clamp(8rem,18vw,14rem); padding:clamp(1.25rem,1.02rem + .72vw,2rem) clamp(2rem,1.45rem + 1.7vw,3.75rem); border:0; border-radius:0; background:var(--color-accent, #7a35ff); color:#fff; font:900 clamp(2.4rem,7.5vw,7.5rem)/.9 Arial Narrow,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.035em; text-decoration:none; text-transform:uppercase; transition:background-color 280ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-cta-editorial:hover { background:var(--color-accent-bright, #925bff); } .ds-cta-editorial:focus-visible { outline:.16rem solid var(--color-focus, #b997ff); outline-offset:.28rem; }

components.name: Editorial Navigation
components.description: Clean structural navigation paired with a visible conversion action and a full-screen mobile dialog.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:clamp(1.25rem,2.6vw,3rem); } .ds-nav a { position:relative; padding:.6rem 0; color:var(--color-ink, #f4f2ed); font:680 clamp(.72rem,.69rem + .12vw,.82rem)/1 Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; text-decoration:none; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-nav a::after { content:''; position:absolute; right:0; bottom:.28rem; left:0; height:.12rem; background:var(--color-accent, #7a35ff); transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:right; transition:transform 280ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav a:hover::after { transform:scaleX(1); transform-origin:left; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:.16rem solid var(--color-focus, #b997ff); outline-offset:.28rem; }

components.name: Photography Frame
components.description: An editorial crop with truthful reference status, caption, and optional monochrome treatment.
components.css: .ds-media { margin:0; color:var(--color-ink, #f4f2ed); } .ds-media-visual { position:relative; min-height:18rem; aspect-ratio:4 / 5; overflow:hidden; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#171717,#050505); filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.12); } .ds-media-visual::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; border:1px solid rgb(244 242 237 / 12%); box-shadow:inset 0 -5rem 5rem -5rem rgb(0 0 0 / 85%); } .ds-media-visual span { position:absolute; z-index:1; top:1rem; left:1rem; padding:.45rem .55rem; background:rgb(5 5 5 / 86%); color:#fff; font:750 .64rem/1 Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.11em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-media figcaption { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:.75rem; padding-top:.75rem; border-top:1px solid rgb(244 242 237 / 18%); font:650 .78rem/1 Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.055em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-media small { color:var(--color-ink-muted, #a8a7a3); font-size:.68rem; }

components.name: Graffiti Label
components.description: A selective handwritten annotation, not a general-purpose heading.
components.css: .ds-graffiti { position:relative; display:inline-block; color:var(--color-accent-bright, #925bff); font:700 clamp(1.15rem,2vw,1.9rem)/.92 Segoe Print,cursive; letter-spacing:-.035em; transform:rotate(-4deg); } .ds-graffiti::after { content:''; position:absolute; right:-.1em; bottom:-.28em; left:-.08em; height:.13em; background:currentColor; clip-path:polygon(0 30%,100% 0,92% 100%,4% 70%); opacity:.75; }

narrative.overview: EVHIL is a premium tattoo-studio system rooted in contemporary graffiti, streetwear editorial composition, rap and urban visual culture, and the raw reality of a working atelier. It must feel dark, confident, artistic, visually rich, and carefully executed—never dirty, amateur, excessively commercial, or like a generic dark SaaS or tattoo template.
keyCharacteristics: Dark material fields, warm ink, sharp editorial rules, and restrained violet.
Asymmetric composition, mixed-scale photography, intentional overlap, and strong vertical rhythm.
Graffiti is expressive and scarce; functional UI stays clean, readable, and direct.
Premium restraint is as important as street credibility; raw never means careless.

rules.name: The Rare Violet Rule
rules.body: Violet is an accent, not a dominant background. Do not create large purple gradients, neon-purple themes, unrelated accents, or random glow.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: A composition may use a handstyle accent and structural display together, but body and conversion UI remain in the clean grotesk.

rules.name: The Work-First Rule
rules.body: No depth effect, texture, motion, or overlay may reduce tattoo inspection or compete with the work.

dos: Do make tattoo work and photography the strongest visual proof, with brand identity immediately visible.
Do use asymmetry, changing density, mixed image scales, full-bleed moments, and editorial whitespace intentionally.
Do use the clean grotesk for functional UI and reserve graffiti/handstyle for controlled brand expression.
Do keep violet scarce, contrast high, focus states clear, controls semantic, and motion optional.
Do use real visual hierarchy, direct Italian CTA copy, and truthful content or explicitly marked temporary material.
donts: Don't default to a centered SaaS hero, repeated three-column cards, bento layouts, generic dark-mode UI, or mechanically alternating sections.
Don't use rounded cards, glassmorphism, gradient meshes, random neon glow, icon circles, decorative pills, or arbitrary purple backgrounds as defaults.
Don't use blackletter, skulls, flames, roses, gothic motifs, cyberpunk effects, or stock tattoo clichés merely because the product is a tattoo studio.
Don't invent artists, biographies, reviews, ratings, awards, prices, statistics, events, availability, or tattoo portfolio claims.
Don't present AI-generated or reference tattoo images as EVHIL work, hide work behind interaction, or sacrifice readability and accessibility for novelty.
